banner.where: lib/presentation/screens/films/films_screen.dart:103 (below the first loaded shelf) and lib/presentation/screens/film/film_detail_screen.dart:325 (detail page) - own AdBannerWidget (lib/presentation/widgets/ads/ad_banner_widget.dart), not AglAdBanner

interstitial.why: No interstitial anywhere (grep InterstitialAd|onTransition in lib: no hit; app_constants.dart:38 'The app shows one ad format, the banner'). Keep it out of a video player.

native.why: Search returns a paged, lazily built vertical list of Internet Archive films ('N films in the archive' header, Load more) - the results case, and the search screen has no banner today. Insert AglNativeAd as its own row after every 8th FilmRow (adjust itemCount/index math). Not in the horizontal shelf carousels (films_screen.dart:167), Library (user's own history/saved), the player or the contact sheet (specs/yourtube.md:246). Phone/tablet only: skip when TvPlatform.isTV (main_scaffold.dart:74).

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none (recentLimit/watchedLimit/resumeLimit in providers are storage caps, not user quotas)
rewarded.why: All films are free public-domain items; no quota, premium or IAP (grep premium|in_app_purchase|quota|paywall: no hit). Nothing honest to reward.

blockers: yourtube imports agl_ads only for AglConsent (lib/main.dart:45-49, ad_banner_widget.dart:35) and never calls AglAds.configure, so AglNativeAd would render nothing (it needs AglAds.ids/isEnabled, packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ad_native.dart:48). Add AglAds.configure(AglAdIds.fromEnvironment(androidAppId: 'ca-app-pub-8528784688453695~2593320348', iosAppId: 'ca-app-pub-8528784688453695~7914938945')) in main; do NOT also call AglAds.initialize() (main.dart already runs AglConsent.gather + MobileAds.instance.initialize at :45-46, and initialize() would add an unused interstitial preload, ads.dart:94).

pubspec.lock pins agl_ads at f0fc3b2, which predates agl-manifest cb21ee5 (git merge-base --is-ancestor: not contained); run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd/showRewarded. google_mobile_ads is locked at 5.3.1 (pubspec.yaml:59 ^5.1.0); agl_ads allows >=5.2.0 <10.0.0 - native template support on 5.3.1 not verified by build.
Hard-coded test device id in release path: MobileAds updateRequestConfiguration testDeviceIds (lib/main.dart:54-58) - harmless for users but worth confirming intended.
